title: dioscorea polyclades var. velutina
intro: Dioscorea polyclades var. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Yam, is a type of yam that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family of plants. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to support joint health and relieve pain. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Yam are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and fibromyalgia. The bioactive constituents of Velvet Yam include diosgenin, a steroidal saponin that has been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activity.
